_comment: Cases for tests/real_pbx.py. Each number must reach the PBX dialplan described in docs/real-pbx.md: the leaf's inbound-dids rule rewrites 44XXXXXXXXXX to 0XXXXXXXXXX, and lab-failover rewrites 447700900999 to 07700900999 and tries pool 2 (an unreachable member first, then the PBX).

answer_pbx_bye.description: Rings 2 s, answers, plays a prompt, the PBX hangs up

answer_uac_bye.description: Answers at once; the caller hangs up after 4 s

busy_486.description: Busy: relayed, no failover, ACK absorbed

unknown_404.description: A number the PBX doesn't have: 404 relayed, no failover

failover_dead_member.description: Pool 2 lists an unreachable member first: 2 s attempt timeout, then the PBX

cancel_ringing.description: The caller cancels while the PBX rings

deadline_503.description: The PBX sends 100 Trying only: 503 at the 8 s setup deadline
